title: Must, need and joining sentences
goal: Say what you have to do and join ideas with but, because, or and and: 'I can't go because I have to eat'.

steps.say: A new, very useful word: bāyad. It means 'must' or 'have to'. Say it out loud: bāyad.
steps.en: must / have to
steps.note: bāyad never changes, whoever is speaking.

steps.say: Now put it in front of a verb you already know. Remember beram, 'to go'? Bāyad beram: literally 'must that-I-go'. Say it.
steps.en: I have to go
steps.note: bāyad + the be- verb: the same slot you used after mikhām.

steps.en: How do you say: I have to go?

steps.say: Now 'come': biyām. Put bāyad in front, and say it out loud.
steps.en: I have to come
How do you say: I have to come there?

steps.say: And eat: bokhoram. Say it out loud, with bāyad first.
steps.en: I have to eat
How do you say: I have to eat here?

steps.say: Here is the lovely part. Bāyad stays exactly the same for everyone. Only the verb changes, as you learned. Bāyad biyāy: you have to come. Say it.
steps.en: you have to come
steps.note: Compare mikhāy / mitūni: the person lives on the verb, not on bāyad.

steps.en: How do you say: You have to go?

steps.say: Now 'he' or 'she': the ending is -e. Fardā, bāyad bere. Say it.
steps.en: tomorrow he/she has to go
How do you say: We have to eat here?
How do you say: Tomorrow I have to go there?

steps.say: Now the opposite. Put na- on bāyad: nabāyad, 'must not' or 'shouldn't'. Nabāyad bokhoram. Say it.
steps.en: I mustn't eat
steps.note: na- here, not ne-: nabāyad, but nemikhām.

steps.en: How do you say: You shouldn't go there?
How do you say: He mustn't come here today?

steps.say: Now we join ideas. Vali means 'but'. Listen: I want to go, but I can't. Mikhām beram, vali nemitūnam. Say it.
steps.en: I want to go but I can't
steps.note: After vali you can drop the verb: nemitūnam alone means 'I can't (do it)'.

steps.en: How do you say: I want to come but I can't?
How do you say: I can't go but you can?

steps.say: Vali works with bāyad too. I want to go, but I have to eat. Say it.
steps.en: I want to go but I have to eat
How do you say: Tomorrow I have to go there but I don't want to?
steps.fa: فردا باید اونجا برم ولی نمی‌خوام
steps.fin: fardā bāyad unjā beram vali nemikhām
steps.hint: After vali: nemikhām on its own.

steps.say: Next word: chon, 'because'. Nemitūnam beram, chon bāyad bokhoram. I can't go because I have to eat. Say it.
steps.en: I can't go because I have to eat
How do you say: I can't come because I have to go there?
steps.fa: نمی‌تونم بیام چون باید اونجا برم
steps.fin: nemitūnam biyām chon bāyad unjā beram

steps.en: How do you say: You can't eat here because we have to go?
steps.fa: نمی‌تونی اینجا بخوری چون باید بریم
steps.fin: nemitūni injā bokhori chon bāyad berim

steps.en: How do you say: Why can't you come??
How do you say: Because I have to go?

steps.say: Now 'or': yā. Say it with me: you can come here or go there. Mitūni injā biyāy yā unjā beri.
steps.en: you can come here or go there
steps.fa: می‌تونی اینجا بیای یا اونجا بری
steps.fin: mitūni injā biyāy yā unjā beri

steps.en: How do you say: Do you want to eat here or go there??
steps.fa: می‌خوای اینجا بخوری یا اونجا بری
steps.fin: mikhāy injā bokhori yā unjā beri
steps.hint: Raise your voice at the end: it's a question.

steps.en: How do you say: He can come today or tomorrow?

steps.say: Last joining word: 'and'. Written it is va, but in speech people just say o. Bāyad beram o bokhoram. I have to go and eat. Say it.
steps.en: I have to go and eat
How do you say: We want to go there and eat?
How do you say: Tonight I have to go but tomorrow I can come?
steps.fa: امشب باید برم ولی فردا می‌تونم بیام
steps.fin: emshab bāyad beram vali fardā mitūnam biyām

steps.en: How do you say: Today I can't go there because I have to come here and eat?
steps.fa: امروز نمی‌تونم اونجا برم چون باید اینجا بیام و بخورم
steps.fin: emruz nemitūnam unjā beram chon bāyad injā biyām o bokhoram

steps.say: Now chain them yourself. Say each whole sentence before you reveal it.

items.en: I want to go but I can't because I have to eat
items.fa: می‌خوام برم ولی نمی‌تونم چون باید بخورم
items.fin: mikhām beram vali nemitūnam chon bāyad bokhoram

items.en: I have to go there tomorrow but I don't want to
items.fa: باید فردا اونجا برم ولی نمی‌خوام
items.fin: bāyad fardā unjā beram vali nemikhām

items.en: You can come here or go there
items.fa: می‌تونی اینجا بیای یا اونجا بری
items.fin: mitūni injā biyāy yā unjā beri

items.en: They can't eat here because they have to go
items.fa: نمی‌تونن اینجا بخورن چون باید برن
items.fin: nemitūnan injā bokhoran chon bāyad beran

items.en: You mustn't go there but he has to go
items.fa: نباید اونجا بری ولی باید بره
items.fin: nabāyad unjā beri vali bāyad bere

items.en: Do you want to come tomorrow or tonight?
I have to eat and go but I can't now
items.fa: باید بخورم و برم ولی الان نمی‌تونم
items.fin: bāyad bokhoram o beram vali alān nemitūnam

items.en: We can't come because we have to go
